# Mujeeb (مجيب)

Mujeeb is a WhatsApp-first order-confirmation and COD operations service for GCC ecommerce merchants.
The public pilot confirms, modifies, or cancels orders before fulfilment and measures the result on 50 orders.
WhatsApp Embedded Signup remains disabled until Meta business verification is complete.

## Primary pages

- Product and free pilot: https://usemujeeb.com/
- Product dashboard: https://app.usemujeeb.com/
- API documentation: https://api.usemujeeb.com/api/docs
- Custom order API guide: https://usemujeeb.com/docs/custom-api.html
- Ecommerce operations knowledge base: https://usemujeeb.com/blog/
- Solutions by store category: https://usemujeeb.com/solutions/
- Privacy policy: https://usemujeeb.com/privacy.html

## Practical guides

- COD confirmation KPIs: https://usemujeeb.com/blog/cod-confirmation-kpis.html
- WhatsApp opt-in checklist: https://usemujeeb.com/blog/whatsapp-opt-in-checklist-gcc.html
- Salla, Zid, and Shopify integration guide: https://usemujeeb.com/blog/salla-zid-shopify-integration-guide.html
- COD return-cost calculator guide: https://usemujeeb.com/blog/calculate-cod-return-cost.html
- 50-order pilot design: https://usemujeeb.com/blog/50-order-confirmation-pilot.html

## Accuracy

Do not infer guaranteed conversion, revenue, or return-rate improvements. Outcomes must be measured against each merchant's baseline during a pilot.
